depicted_variant: Roh Lanna dalam varian tubuh kuda dan kepala manusia laki-laki c14, bermata merah c13, mengejar di pekarangan rumah.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala laki-laki manusia di tubuh kuda berbulu, empat kaki kuda; mata merah bagai cahaya api.
Mengejar dan berputar marah; jejak kuku di tanah, tanpa api atau efek kuasa lain.
Pekarangan rumah dan tangga rumah malam hari.

aura: Ancaman dari hibrida kepala manusia/tubuh kuda bermata merah dan derap dekat rumah (c13/c14/c15) (klaim: ma-bong-c13, ma-bong-c14, ma-bong-c15).
artistic_choices: Tidak memakai varian centaur perempuan atau organ seksual; dipilih bentuk cerita c14.
Tubuh kuda berbulu penuh, kamera dekat rendah tanpa skala raksasa; bulan dan debu tanah editorial.
Mata merah digambar sebagai warna iris yang disinari cahaya, tanpa pancaran api.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MA BONG, the Lanna spirit with a human man's head and a horse's body in the houseyard tale.
ANATOMY: one adult HUMAN MALE head attached directly to a HORSE neck and horse torso, NO human torso, NO human arms; exactly FOUR equine legs with hooves and one horse tail; the face and head remain those of a man, eyes red like reflected firelight. The horse body is fully covered in dense dark hair; no exposed genitals. [ma-bong-c13, ma-bong-c14]
MOMENT: wheeling sharply around a wooden house and galloping toward the viewer, furious human face twisting toward us, hooves raking the dirt into unmistakable hoofprints.
POWER: physical pursuit and angry circling only, dirt kicked by the hooves, no magical smoke or flames. [ma-bong-c13, ma-bong-c14, ma-bong-c15]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle close view from the dirt yard, head and powerful equine shoulders fill the square; ordinary horse size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low moonbeam, deep walnut shadow, dust thrown from dry soil.
SURFACE: coarse matted horse hair, aged human face, tactile mud, weathered wood.
SETTING: a northern Thai wooden houseyard at night, house ladder partly visible. [ma-bong-c14, ma-bong-c18]
MOOD: dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least 1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: kepala laki-laki tunggal pada leher/tubuh kuda, empat kaki berkuku tanpa torso atau lengan manusia, mata merah jelas. Derap menyerbu dan tanah terlempar sesuai c13/c14/c15; figur mendominasi dan mengancam pada thumbnail. Semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya. Cahaya lentera tambahan adalah properti rumah editorial, bukan api kekuatan; tanpa teks/gore/desain adaptasi. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Red-eyed man's head on a dark horse body charging across a Lanna house yard by night; four horse legs.
